title: Say Pinataynan ed Hardin
intro: Sakey a misteryoson pinalsa so datin manaayam ed sankatageyan a rangko na pinalsa, a mas asingger ed Madibinon nen say natalosan na dakel. Balet linmesa so inkamapaatagey, tan say sakey a gawa na panagsumlang so anguman ed kurso na kiwawala. Natan, sayan pinalsa et manliliberliber bilang sakey a kalaban, a manbubulong tan manplaplano anggad onsabi so insipan ya agew. Sarag mon naamtaan so pakabidbiran na sayan atumba?
clues: Sakey ak nensaman ed saramay sankaasinggeran ed Madibinon kiwawala, ya intagey nen say maslak a pinalsa.
Pinalsa ak manlapud mansasnit ya elemento, aliwan manlapud dalin odino pitek.
Nen ingganggan ak ya onyuko ed arap na balon pinalsa, agko inmabuloy — lapud papanisiaan kon inkasuperyor ko.
Siak so pinataynan tan sinumpa, balet diad kaunoran et naikdan ak na panaon anggad sakey a kabkabat tan aturon panaon.
Insipan kon palikdoen ko so dakel anggad nayarian ko, ya onasingger ed ilalak nen Adan manlapud amin a direksion.
Siak so lukas, indeklaran kalaban na amin a katooan, a lawas manplaplano tan manbubulong anggad aturon anggaan.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
